title: Upstage Launches Studio, Advancing Intelligent Document Processing from Data Extraction to Business Action
markdown:
[![Untitled UI logotext](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6743d5190bb2b52f38e99e37/6743f495cc3c0ed693e0b5f3_Logo_Black.avif)![Logo](https://cdn.prod.website-files.com/6743d5190bb2b52f38e99e37/6743f49549daa3311a34cabb_Symbol_Black.avif)](https://www.upstage.ai/)

_The new Upstage Studio product connects contracts, invoices, and records scattered across organizations, catching revenue leaks, cutting manual work, and getting to market faster._

SAN JOSE, Calif. (October 6, 2026) Today, Upstage, an enterprise AI company, today launched [Upstage Studio](https://www.upstage.ai/products/studio), the next-generation of its intelligent document processing (IDP) platform. The latest version of Upstage Studio transforms scattered unstructured documents into organized intelligence that is put to work in customized workflows.

Document chaos and workflow inefficiencies cause companies to leave money on the table that they don’t know exists. Segmented workflows living within different systems result in money leaking between the informational cracks. Even with document processing technology, businesses rely heavily on manual work to read documents, check information, re-key data, and reconcile information across systems.

Upstage Studio automates manual tasks while maintaining human control for critical high-level processes. The platform works by extracting reliable data from unstructured enterprise information. It then goes beyond simple extraction to validate, provide context, connect relevant information, and move it through a customized controlled workflow with human oversight. Workflows are simple to set up and are put to work in hours rather than months.

Underneath every workflow put in place, Upstage Studio uses uploaded documents to build a connected picture of the business. Customers, suppliers, contracts, shipments, and invoices are linked together and kept current as new documents arrive, so the answers are there when a team needs them. The platform leverages Upstage’s [sophisticated document models](https://www.upstage.ai/blog/en/solar-pro-4) to accurately read documents, flagging for human review as needed. Every flag includes a reason and evidence for bringing in a human.

> "Upstage Studio was designed to address the same issue nearly every company flags for us,” said [Kasey Roh](https://www.linkedin.com/in/kaseyroh/), US CEO of Upstage. "The information organizations need to run their operations sits in their documents, but it's scattered across contracts, invoices, and email attachments. Their team members are unable to connect the information fast enough to act when needed. With the new version of Upstage Studio, a team can start with one workflow, see what it recovers, and build from there."

Upstage Studio launches with workflows built for the document-heavy operations where money leaks first. Insurance underwriting teams link submissions, ACORD forms, loss runs, and broker email into a single picture per risk, clearing more submissions in binding season. Banks and lenders connect credit files, financial statements, and tax returns into one borrower view, flagging inconsistencies before a file reaches committee. Manufacturing procurement teams match supplier contracts, purchase orders, and invoices to catch charges that don't reflect negotiated terms, and logistics teams reconcile freight invoices and bills of lading against contracted rates across every shipment instead of an audited sample.

Businesses have tried to close these gaps before, and most approaches fall short. Manual review is accurate but slow, forcing teams to check a small sample instead of every document. OCR and extraction tools read documents well, but they don't connect what's inside them and need new templates for every form. AI chatbots can find similar passages, but they can't link a contract to the invoice it governs. Consulting-led data projects can connect everything, but they take months and a large budget before they deliver. Upstage Studio is built to do both: connect information across documents and get a team running on its first workflow fast.

These workflows run across manufacturing and industrial companies, logistics and supply chain, insurance, and financial services.

> "Reading one document accurately is table stakes," said [Lucy Park](https://www.linkedin.com/in/echojuliett/?isSelfProfile=false), Chief Product Officer, Upstage. "The hard part is connecting what's in thousands of them and keeping that picture up to date. That's what we built this version of Upstage Studio to do, and it gets more valuable with every document it processes."

Upstage's document AI processes more than 3 million pages a day for over 100 global enterprises. A global semiconductor company using Upstage’s technology cut its invoice processing time by about 80%, from 8 minutes to roughly 1.5 minutes per invoice. [Amwins Group Benefits](https://www.upstage.ai/customers/amwins), a leading global distributor of specialty insurance products and services in the US, cut invoice processing from as long as two hours to under five minutes across more than 80 carrier formats, with a three-month payback.

The latest version of Upstage Studio is available today. Teams can sign up at Upstage [Studio.upstage.ai](https://studio.upstage.ai/) or request a demo at [upstage.ai](https://www.upstage.ai/products/studio).
